entities.summary: Ludwig "Lutz" Beckmann was a German Luftstreitkräfte ace during World War I and a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross during World War II. Ludwig Beckmann claimed eight aerial victories during World War I all on the Western Front.
